explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem shows that two sets are equal, and both come from the library: `AspPerm.inset`, the inversion set of an ASP permutation of ℤ, and `northwestSet`. All of its content lies in those definitions and in the library's own lemma `AspPerm.inv_iff_le`. The proof uses only set extensionality, destructuring and `le_of_lt`, which are generic logic. Mathlib has no concept of AspPerm, inversion sets or northwest sets, so no Mathlib declaration can carry this content. I did not run a separate search of Mathlib.
